title: Keep Working
subtitle: Complete artwork of a prototype mini-game
description:
Keep Working is a 2D platform videogame with comical and chaotic physics, developed for the Serious Games course at the university. In addition to its design, I made the illustrations and visual art, using a cartoon and comic style that contrasts with the critical tone of the project.

The story takes place in a warehouse of a logistics company dedicated to online shopping, where the player assumes the role of a worker who must sort and move boxes against the clock, facing surreal and exaggerated situations that convey stress, confusion and lack of rest. The pace is constant, frenetic and challenging.

At the end of the game, the game reveals that all the situations experienced are inspired by real cases, with the aim of raising the player's awareness of the harsh working conditions and motivating them to support the cause of the affected workers.
